17.t: GAME ADJUSTMENTS To change the Game Adjustments, use the DIP switches on the CPU.
The Adjustments allow the operator to change the game Pricing and Difficulty levels, among other game features. Use the following DIP switch tables to change the desired adjustment.
swi   sw2   sw3|   sw4]sws   swe |   sw7 |]   sws
Start/Continue 1 credit start, 1 credit continue* Off 2 credits start, 1 credit continue On
Coin Meters Meter 1 sums all switches Off Meter 1=switch 1, (3); Meter 2=switch 2, (4) On (UK Electronic Door-Meter 1 is #10 Pence units through all switches.)
